metadata.description: Evidence-led audit, architecture, prompts, prose editing, human runbooks, source-backed documentation, and repository/Copilot review instructions.

plugins.name: audit-workflow
plugins.description: Evidence-first audit lifecycle with read-only deep review, feature-scattering analysis, shared fix proof, independent verification, hooks, and MCP tools.

plugins.name: system-architect
plugins.description: Implementation-ready architecture SPECs, reviews, design decisions, optional planning profiles, and evidence-based project recovery.

plugins.name: prompt-design
plugins.description: Create, rewrite, diagnose, adapt, and evaluate usable prompts, including source-backed service-to-prompt translation.

plugins.name: human-runbooks
plugins.description: Draft, update, and resume human-executed procedures with explicit actions, observations, retry decisions, and final validation.

plugins.name: codebase-docs
plugins.description: Document implemented systems through source-backed PRDs and local wikis, with explicit static extraction limits and non-destructive output handling.

plugins.name: repo-instructions
plugins.description: Create and review scoped Claude/Codex repository instructions, and design repository-specific GitHub Copilot Code Review customization from source and review history.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Detect and revise formulaic prose in technical documentation, PRs, review comments, and everyday writing while preserving meaning, technical facts, and the author's voice.
